response_summary: Late-recorded verification: confirmed owner/coordinator authorization, exact branch/base equality, and NEXUS/TUSKER semantic acceptance with transport/API and runtime integration still blocked; no code changes in that response.

AEGIS-06-RUNTIME-001: implemented isolated deny-by-default policy, exact-bound approval lifecycle, SQLite atomic one-time consume/reconciliation, narrow broker authorization gate, HMAC audit and adversarial tests; 10 runtime tests passed locally; privileged NEXUS dispatch remains disabled.

Added externally retained HMAC audit checkpoints and rollback/truncation verification with adversarial regression coverage; prior runtime head passed 174 security tests in GitHub CI and unified validation; checkpoint regression test awaits CI.

Closed an authorization-state disclosure gap by binding consume reconciliation to the original authenticated principal, session and device; added cross-identity regression coverage and verified both security and unified CI.

Hardened policy resource resolution against dropped, added or widened resources; action digest now binds both caller-requested resource identifiers and resolver-canonical identifiers; added adversarial regression tests.

Closed a consume replay disclosure gap by checking authenticated principal, session and device bindings before returning ALREADY_CONSUMED or a consumption ID; added regression coverage for all three mismatches and verified both security and unified CI.

Bound canonical resource IDs returned by the policy resource resolver to 1,024 characters, fail-closed on oversized resolver output, added a regression test, and verified both security and unified CI.
Escalated executable-resource operations to R4 approval risk, added a policy regression assertion, and aligned the runtime security documentation.

Made registry resource declarations fail closed when malformed or ambiguous: rejects duplicate resource kinds, duplicate or unknown access modes, empty access lists, and unexpected declaration fields; added parameterized regression coverage.

Hardened trusted registry identity scope validation: allowed origins must be unique members of the trusted origin set; principal-class lists must contain unique bounded strings; malformed authenticated principal classes are rejected. Added 12 adversarial regression cases.

Hardened registry numeric and shape validation: explicitly reject Python booleans for timeout/input-byte integer limits, reject malformed registry sequences and non-mapping entries before lookup, and bound policy/registry version identifiers; added four adversarial regression cases.

Aligned defensive operation-registration validation with the complete v0.1.0 schema contract: required fields, property allowlist, identifier/version bounds, resource/precondition limits, rate-limit shape, risk-escalation shape, and approval/risk constraints; updated fixtures, added eleven malformed-entry regression cases, and documented that shape validation does not replace signature trust.

Fixed operation-registration semantic-version regex and validate every signed registry entry before action lookup; added regression coverage proving malformed unrelated entries invalidate the registry.

Hardened HMAC audit-chain verification to reject non-integer/bool checkpoint sequences and SQLite sequence gaps or renumbering even when event payload hashes remain valid; added adversarial regression coverage and documented the invariant.

Closed the empty-chain audit checkpoint ambiguity: sequence-zero checkpoints must carry the fixed all-zero genesis hash even when their MAC is otherwise valid; added a forged-MAC regression test and documented the invariant.

Hardened external audit checkpoint creation to verify the complete local HMAC chain before signing; corrupted or sequence-invalid database state now raises SecurityStoreError instead of receiving a fresh trusted checkpoint. Added adversarial regression coverage and documented the fail-closed behavior.

Aligned consume authorization-reference validation with reconciliation: enforce a 1–512 character bound and strict UTF-8, fail closed on malformed references, and add regression coverage proving rejected values do not mutate authorization state; both required CI workflows passed on the exact code head.

Closed a policy resource-scope gap: proposals with zero concrete resources now fail closed with POLICY_SCOPE_EXCEEDED instead of reaching resolver/precondition evaluation; added regression coverage and verified both required CI workflows on the exact code head.
